decisions: Three-run Native uncapped and Auto-to-Native VSync 1080p-estimate campaigns pass current software gates separately.
Single MSAA 2x trial is about 4.4 percent faster than the baseline median; insufficient evidence for changing the 4x default.
Single half-scale trial is about 1.98 times baseline FPS; pixel sensitivity is substantial, but quality and a paired sustained benefit are unqualified.
Native 2560x1600 trial is valid but fails p95 and p99 pacing thresholds.
Auto 2560x1600 trial has a valid stream and stable selected policy, but effective MetalFX execution is unknown; health/workload qualification is rejected, and p95 also exceeds the threshold.
Keep current defaults and conservative bounds off; do not extrapolate M1 results to M2-M6.
